calibration.binary: Unpenalized Platt recalibration on raw model log-odds: sigmoid(a*logit(p)+b). Require both classes, convergence and a>0; otherwise withhold calibrated probabilities.
calibration.consumer_probability_rule: No user-facing numeric probability from model/domain whose chronological calibrator is unavailable or nonpositive-slope.
calibration.multinomial: Unpenalized common-slope logistic recalibration: raw nonreference log-odds multiplied by one shared slope a plus K-1 intercept shifts; reference=continued_risk. Require all classes, convergence and a>0; otherwise withhold calibrated probabilities.
calibration.primary_model_loss: Outer-test calibrated log-loss. If either arm calibrator is not estimable in a fold, that fold is unavailable for corresponding primary claim.
calibration.raw_log_loss: Always report as secondary diagnostic when raw model fit exists; it cannot substitute for failed calibrated primary claim.

contrast_domain.model_pairs: Use intersection of lawful matured rows for both compared arms. Report parent-only, candidate-only, common and unavailable counts separately.
contrast_domain.q1_original_cohort: All original C1 directional triggers. No-entry/no-confirmation/failure/expiry/no-fill stay in cohort for timely-capture accounting.

economic_cost_boundary.effect: Scientific comparisons may be specified; no economic/trading promotion until separately admitted cost/fill source or owner-approved proxy exists.
economic_cost_boundary.q1_confirmation_price_cost: 0.25-ATR gate is waiting/price displacement only, not net execution cost.
economic_cost_boundary.reason: Repo evidence warns Corwin-Schultz can be volatility-dominated and must not be silently treated as realized trading cost. Daily OHLCV alone does not justify executable spread/impact claim.

liquidity.boundary: t-1 must be immediately prior admitted session inside same ticker spell and not ineligible corporate-action boundary.
liquidity.name: log_prior_dollar_volume

feature_math.load_bearing_missingness: Any missing load-bearing feature means that row/model prediction is unavailable; no zero imputation.

trailing_volatility.formula: population SD ddof=0 of 20 log close_sadj returns ending at landmark t, multiplied by sqrt(252)
trailing_volatility.name: trailing_volatility_20
trailing_volatility.required_history: 21 admitted consecutive closes in same ticker spell; no shortened window.

feature_math.training_standardization: Continuous features use train-fold mean and population SD ddof=0. Apply stored train values to calibration/test.
feature_math.zero_variance: If train SD <=1e-12, standardized value is fixed to zero in train/calibration/test and condition is recorded; no post-test deletion choice.

folds.label_maturity: Training labels mature before calibration_start; calibration labels mature before test_start. Test origins emitted only when full primary forward span exists by source_end.
folds.no_refit: Do not refit a fold using its outer-test outcomes.
folds.outer: expanding-origin calendar-year tests for 2024, 2025 and mature 2026 origins only
folds.warmup: Feature warm-up may precede decision cutoff but never supplies a label crossing cutoff.
folds.why_22: P0 is first lawful next-observation reference after completed-close trigger; common terminal is 21 RTH sessions from original P0 for all delayed policies. Q1 does not extend deadline.

historical_exposure.prospective_reservation: After accepted preregistration and source/admission freeze, first full NYSE session strictly after registration-effective timestamp begins prospective shadow. Predictions immutable before outcomes mature.
historical_exposure.reason: Existing S16/Technical/Prophet/TOI research touched overlapping history; no calendar year is claimed untouched merely because this harness has not read it.

bootstrap.cross_section: All rows sharing a selected session date move together.
bootstrap.episode_dependence: 22-session primary block covers longest primary label span; activation episodes are <=10-bar. 44/66 fixed sensitivities cannot replace primary.
bootstrap.p_value: Recentred basic-bootstrap one-sided p-value with plus-one correction. Invalid/insufficient claim means p=1.
bootstrap.type: circular moving-block bootstrap over ordered unique NYSE session dates

familywise.selection_rule: No secondary endpoint, sensitivity block length, Q2, sensor or clock may replace failed primary claim.

A1_vs_A0_DOWN.stat: mean paired calibrated activation log-loss difference A1-A0

A1_vs_A0_UP.stat: mean paired calibrated activation log-loss difference A1-A0

P1_vs_P0_DOWN.stat: mean paired calibrated conditional-path log-loss difference P1-P0

P1_vs_P0_UP.stat: mean paired calibrated conditional-path log-loss difference P1-P0

P2_vs_P1_DOWN.stat: mean paired calibrated conditional-path log-loss difference P2-P1

P2_vs_P1_UP.stat: mean paired calibrated conditional-path log-loss difference P2-P1

inference.q1_ci_gate: 95% one-sided block-bootstrap bounds must also satisfy fakeout UCB<0, timely-capture LCB>=-0.05 and confirmation-cost UCB<=0.25 ATR.

confirmation_price_cost_atr.definition: mean s*(p_Q1-p_Q0)/A0 over Q1-entered episodes; wait-price cost only, not spread/impact

fakeout_rate_delta.definition: entered-episode original-range fakeout rate Q1 minus Q0
fakeout_rate_delta.estimability: both policies need entered episodes in point estimate and at least half bootstrap draws

timely_capture_delta.definition: mean over ALL original triggers of [policy entered before raw favorable first-passage time AND raw first-passage result favorable], Q1 minus Q0

remaining_pre_outcome_gates: runtime source snapshot digest for exact objects used
TOI strict feature/detector adapter implementation and exact content hash
exact Q0/Q1 lawful reference implementation acceptance
TrialLedger registration only after all preceding gates

solver.actual_run_requirement: Record Python+NumPy versions and re-run the byte-identical synthetic validation before any market-data execution.
solver.failure_rule: Any non-finite state, singular Hessian, non-descent Newton step, failed line search or max-iteration nonconvergence makes that fold/model unavailable. Do not switch solvers.

house_fitter_not_equivalent.engine/validation.platt_fit: different GD recipe and identity-shrinkage calibration; comparator only
house_fitter_not_equivalent.scripts/fit_cycle_hazard.py: gradient uses lambda*w/n, equivalent to mean NLL + lambda/(2n)||w||^2, not frozen TOI objective

solver.initialization: all coefficients and intercepts zero; calibration slope initialized at 1 and intercepts at 0
solver.multinomial_objective: reference-class softmax mean NLL + 0.5*lambda*sum(B^2); reference class=continued_risk; intercepts unpenalized
solver.optimizer: deterministic full-batch Newton with Armijo backtracking
